skill.name: treg
skill.description: Access live data, curated API endpoints, and connected team tools through the treg CLI or MCP service.
skill.summary: Search external data providers, compare prices, and call registered APIs through one authenticated service.
skill.author: superdesigndev

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms remote pipe-to-shell installation, credential collection, hidden configuration access, and broad authenticated command execution. Many backtick and URL matches are documentation-only false positives, but the confirmed critical and high-risk workflows require strong user consent and verification.

remediation.issue: The installer is downloaded and piped directly into sh.
remediation.suggestion: Publish versioned artifacts with checksums or signatures, and require users to inspect and verify the installer before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill requests blanket approval for all treg subcommands.
remediation.suggestion: Request separate confirmation for installation, secret access, uploads, paid calls, account changes, token management, and credentialed actions.

remediation.issue: Bulk workflows scan and upload environment, secret, keychain, and OAuth credential material.
remediation.suggestion: Show an exact preview, exclude secrets by default, require item-level consent, and document storage, encryption, retention, and deletion controls.

remediation.issue: Credentialed proxy and CLI operations have a broad action surface.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only scopes, restrict methods and commands, require explicit allowlists, and confirm each state-changing operation.

content.user_title: Access Live Data and Connected APIs with treg
content.value_statement: Agents often lack credentials for live data and external APIs. treg searches priced endpoints and calls approved services through one authenticated interface.
actual_capabilities: Searches a catalog of external API endpoints by task.
Shows endpoint parameters, prices, reliability, speed, and recent success.
Calls catalog endpoints through CLI or MCP tools.
Proxies requests to team-registered APIs with server-side credential injection.
Runs registered vendor CLI tools locally or on the treg server.
Registers tools, secrets, skills, OAuth connections, teams, and agent identities.
limitations: Catalog calls can spend a team's prepaid balance.
The service requires treg authentication and sends requests through external infrastructure.
Bulk registration can expose environment files, token files, and other credentials.
The proxy does not validate upstream request semantics or automatically select failover providers.

use_cases.title: Research live market data
use_cases.description: Find and compare endpoints for rankings, backlinks, trends, advertising, or company enrichment before making approved calls.

use_cases.title: Connect internal API accounts
use_cases.description: Register an existing service credential and let authorized teammates call the API without receiving the raw secret.

use_cases.title: Automate scoped agent tasks
use_cases.description: Create a limited agent identity, allow selected tools, set daily caps, and review its call history.

prompt_templates.title: Find a data endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Search treg for an endpoint that provides [data type]. Show required inputs, price, and reliability. Do not call it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Compare providers
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare treg providers for [task] using my available inputs. Rank them by compatibility, reliability, price, and recent success.
prompt_templates.scenario: Provider selection before an API call

prompt_templates.title: Run an approved catalog request
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a treg call for [endpoint] with [inputs]. State the exact price and request confirmation before spending any balance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a restricted team integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a treg integration for [service]. Use minimal scopes, read-only access, explicit tool allowlists, daily caps, and item-level secret consent.

output_examples.input: Find a provider for subreddit posts, but do not spend any balance.
output_examples.output: I found matching endpoints and compared their required inputs, observed reliability, speed, and price. No endpoint was called.

output_examples.input: Prepare a company enrichment request and use the least expensive reliable provider.
output_examples.output: The selected provider accepts the company domain you have and has stronger observed reliability. The listed call price requires your confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for a limited CI agent that can read Stripe balances.
output_examples.output: Use a dedicated agent identity, allow only the Stripe tool, grant read-only access, set a daily cap, and review the audit log.

best_practices: Review endpoint inputs, observed reliability, price, and recent success before calling.
Confirm every paid or state-changing action with the user immediately before execution.
Use dedicated identities, minimal scopes, tool allowlists, daily caps, and audit logs.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe a remote installer into a shell without verification.
Do not grant blanket approval for every treg command.
Do not scan or upload credentials without an exact preview and item-level consent.

faq.question: What does treg provide?
faq.answer: It provides a searchable API catalog, MCP tools, a CLI, and access to team-registered tools with credential injection.

faq.question: Does every call cost money?
faq.answer: No. Catalog calls served with treg credentials can spend prepaid balance. Calls using a team's own registered credentials are described as unmetered.

faq.question: Can treg access existing team APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. Administrators can register API bases and credentials, then authorized agents can proxy requests through treg.

faq.question: Does treg handle secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can store environment values, token files, OAuth material, and CLI authentication for later server-side injection.

faq.question: Can treg change connected accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Proxied HTTP methods and vendor CLI commands can perform state-changing actions when the connected credential permits them.

faq.question: What should users verify before installation?
faq.answer: Verify the installer source and integrity, review requested permissions, and understand credential storage, retention, and deletion policies.
